item.title: I'm making a game, I don't know how, would you play it ?
item.description:
I had this game idea for years now, and I just can't understand why no one thought about it before
It's like football manager but with a Private military company. You have to have to start from scratch, everything is upgradable your character, your stuff, your guys, their stuff, their stats etc, you can buy weapons, equipment, food, tech, you have to manage your crew, where do you stay, decide what kind of PMC you are.
